title: FlowBudget: Training-Free Sampling-Budget Estimation for Flow Matching Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.20636v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sampling from continuous flow-based generators such as flow matching models requires numerical ODE or SDE integration, making inference cost depend on the number of function evaluations (NFEs). In practice, the sampling budget is inherited from prior work or selected through expensive FID-versus-NFE sweeps, using FID to assess image-generation quality, requiring sample generation and evaluation at multiple budgets. This makes sampling-budget selection dependent on repeated empirical evaluation. We therefore ask a complementary question to solver design and timestep allocation: for a fixed pretrained model and solver, what numerical resolution is sufficient? We introduce FLOWBUDGET, a training-free estimator of solver-relative sampling complexity. Using simulation-free interpolation probes of the learned dynamics, FLOWBUDGET normalizes the leading one-step discretization error by the motion, estimates its coefficient from interpolation pr

translated_title: FlowBudget：面向流匹配模型的免训练采样预算估计
translated_abstract: 从流匹配模型这类基于连续流的生成器中进行采样，需要对常微分方程（ODE）或随机微分方程（SDE）进行数值积分，这使得推理成本取决于函数评估次数（NFE）。在实践中，采样预算往往继承自先前工作，或通过代价高昂的“FID-对-NFE”扫描来选择（即使用FID评估图像生成质量），这需要在多个预算下反复生成并评估样本，使采样预算的选择依赖于大量的经验性评估。因此，我们提出了一个与求解器设计和时间步分配互补的问题：对于一个固定的预训练模型和求解器，多大的数值分辨率才是足够的？我们提出了FLOWBUDGET，一种求解器相对采样复杂度的免训练估计器。FLOWBUDGET利用对所学动力学的免模拟插值探针，将主导性的一步离散化误差按运动量进行归一化，并通过插值探针估计其系数，从而判断所需的采样预算。
tldr: 提出FlowBudget，一种免训练的采样预算估计方法，通过免模拟插值探针为流匹配模型确定足够的数值求解分辨率（NFE），从而避免昂贵且重复的FID-NFE扫描。
